records.name: Sydney

salary_usd_year.note: levels.fyi Sydney: AU$170,318 entry-level / AU$169,006 senior (total comp, self-reported, skewed toward large multinational employers — Atlassian, Google, Apple, The Trade Desk). Entry and senior are unusually close due to a thin, big-tech-heavy sample; treat as an upper-bound signal rather than typical market pay. Mid-level (3-5y) not found in any source (levels.fyi, SEEK, Hays).

tehran_travel.note: Typical routing via DXB or DOH (~14h Sydney-Gulf leg + layover + ~2h Gulf-Tehran hop) — estimate

records.tech_scene_note: Australia's largest and highest-paying tech hub — Atlassian's HQ plus large engineering offices for Google, Apple and fintech firms, though also the most competitive and expensive market.

records.name: Melbourne

salary_usd_year.note: levels.fyi Melbourne: AU$83,255 median entry-level, AU$148,803 senior (total comp, self-reported, includes named employers like Microsoft). Mid-level (3-5y) not found in available sources (levels.fyi, SEEK, Hays).

tehran_travel.note: Typical routing via DXB or DOH, similar duration to Sydney — estimate

records.tech_scene_note: Home to over half of Australia's top 20 tech companies and roughly a third of the national ICT workforce, with a strong overlay of biotech/health-tech and corporate-HQ software teams (Telstra, CSL, major banks).

records.name: Brisbane

salary_usd_year.note: levels.fyi Brisbane: AU$73,880-130,900 entry-level range (midpoint used), total comp, self-reported. Senior uses the AU-wide levels.fyi band AU$153,792-218,836 (midpoint) since a Brisbane-specific senior figure wasn't surfaced — flagged as a national, not city-specific, proxy. Mid-level (3-5y) not found.

tehran_travel.note: Typical routing via DXB or DOH — estimate

records.tech_scene_note: A smaller but growing secondary tech market concentrated in the CBD and Fortitude Valley, with IT recognized as a core white-collar industry alongside mining, banking and insurance.

records.name: Perth

salary_usd_year.note: levels.fyi Perth: AU$71,901-99,970 entry-level range and AU$113,110-192,569 senior range (midpoints used), total comp, self-reported. Mid-level (3-5y) not found. Perth shows the lowest software-engineer pay of the four major AU cities researched.

tehran_travel.note: Via DXB — Perth-Dubai (~11h) is the shortest Australia-Gulf leg of any researched AU city — estimate

records.tech_scene_note: A resources/mining-dominated economy overall, but home to a genuine startup scene (Canva got its start here) alongside a smaller, lower-paying software job market than the eastern capitals.

records.name: Adelaide

salary_usd_year.note: New-grad from Indeed 'Junior Software Engineer' avg AU$76,708; mid from SEEK Adelaide median AU$110,000 (job-ad based, largest/most robust city figure available); senior from Indeed 'Senior Software Engineer' avg AU$113,008. PayScale samples (n=20-111) broadly consistent but smaller.

tehran_travel.note: Direct Emirates (ADL-DXB) and Qatar Airways (ADL-DOH) both confirmed operating; then DXB/DOH-IKA — estimate

records.tech_scene_note: Australia's defence-technology and space hub — BAE Systems, Saab, Raytheon and Lockheed Martin cluster around Technology Park, and it's home to the Australian Space Agency, supporting above-market senior salaries.

records.name: Gold Coast

salary_usd_year.note: New-grad from Indeed 'Junior Software Engineer' avg AU$75,498; mid from SEEK Gold Coast median AU$86,000 (lowest of the 8 AU cities researched, corroborated by Indeed's AU$86,164 general average); senior from Indeed 'Senior Software Engineer' avg AU$118,041.

tehran_travel.note: No direct long-haul from Gold Coast (OOL) — domestic connection via BNE/SYD, then DXB/DOH, then IKA — estimate

records.tech_scene_note: A tourism, health and construction-driven economy with limited dedicated tech employers; increasingly functions as a lower-cost remote-work and film/digital-production satellite of Brisbane.

records.name: Hobart

salary_usd_year.note: New-grad from Indeed 'Junior Software Engineer' avg AU$77,946; mid from SEEK Hobart median AU$91,980 (identical to SEEK's Tasmania state-wide figure); senior from Indeed 'Senior Software Engineer' avg AU$141,066. Smallest sample sizes of the researched AU cities (Numbeo: 22 contributors) — lower confidence.

tehran_travel.note: No direct long-haul from Hobart (HBA is a domestic-only airport) — connection via MEL/SYD, then DXB/DOH, then IKA — estimate

records.tech_scene_note: Australia's Antarctic and Southern Ocean science gateway (Australian Antarctic Division, IMAS) drives a niche in marine/polar research computing, alongside a small, thin general software job market.

records.name: Canberra

salary_usd_year.note: New-grad from Indeed 'Junior Software Engineer' avg AU$94,869; mid from SEEK Canberra/ACT median AU$125,290 (highest of the 8 AU cities, reflecting a government/defence premium); senior from Indeed 'Senior Software Engineer' avg AU$137,480 (also highest). PayScale's Canberra page is stale (last updated 2018) and was excluded.

tehran_travel.note: Canberra (CBR) has no scheduled DXB/DOH nonstop as of Aug 2026 (confirmed via flightconnections.com — only Denpasar and Nadi are international nonstop) — connect via SYD/MEL, then DXB/DOH, then IKA — estimate

records.tech_scene_note: Dominated by public administration plus a dense cluster of defence, cybersecurity and government-IT contractors (Leidos, CSIRO, Geoscience Australia), which pushes software salaries here above every other researched Australian city.

records.name: Dubai

salary_usd_year.note: levels.fyi Dubai: AED120,000 entry-level median / AED367,300 senior median (total comp, self-reported, skewed toward large multinationals — Amazon Dubai reports AED554K-645K). GulfTalent's thinner sample (n=24-29) shows notably lower averages: AED72,000 general / AED144,000 senior. Mid-level (3-5y) not found in a verifiable single source. Salaries are tax-free in the UAE.

tehran_travel.note: Direct DXB-IKA (~2h10m flight, currently operated by Mahan Air) — estimate; carrier availability on this route may fluctuate given regional tensions in 2026

records.tech_scene_note: The Gulf's largest commercial tech hub — Dubai Internet City, Media City and Silicon Oasis host regional offices of Google, Microsoft, Oracle, IBM and Amazon, with DIFC anchoring fintech and no personal income tax.

records.name: Abu Dhabi

salary_usd_year.note: No Abu Dhabi-specific GulfTalent page exists (UAE-wide avg is AED84,000/yr, n=71, thin). levels.fyi Abu Dhabi entry AED162,009-264,999 / senior AED312,042-460,262 (midpoints used) is heavily skewed by sovereign-wealth/finance employers (Abu Dhabi Investment Authority reports AED522K-745K, First Abu Dhabi Bank ~AED286K) — treat as an elite-employer upper bound, not typical market pay. Mid-level not found. Tax-free.

tehran_travel.note: No scheduled direct AUH-IKA route as of Aug 2026 (Wikipedia notes UAE-Iran flight disruption following 2026 regional strikes) — connects via DXB or DOH, a short ~1h regional hop plus layover plus ~2h to IKA — estimate

records.tech_scene_note: A government-backed AI and fintech push via Hub71 (Microsoft-partnered) and G42, with sovereign-wealth investors (Mubadala, ADQ, ADIA) giving the scene a distinct enterprise/AI tilt versus Dubai's broader commercial mix.

records.name: Doha

salary_usd_year.note: PayScale Qatar (thin, n=7-14): early-career (1-4y) QAR95,585 used for new_grad, corroborated by Glassdoor's Ogoul Technology median of QAR96,000; mid-career QAR110,000. Senior uses Glassdoor's Rheinmetall Barzan Advanced Technologies median QAR216,000; levels.fyi Doha shows a wider all-experience range of QAR95,998-262,296. All Doha salary sources are thin — indicative only. Tax-free.

tehran_travel.note: Direct DOH-IKA (~2h10m flight, Qatar Airways) — estimate; add buffer for airport processes

records.tech_scene_note: Tech is an explicit pillar of Qatar's diversification strategy — Google opened a Doha cloud region in 2023, Microsoft has tripled local headcount in two years, and government programs have backed 500+ startups, most of them AI-focused.
